panels.title: Trade Net (realised)
panels.description: Cargo sales minus cargo purchases for operation_type='tour' in the window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS "trade net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'

       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.title: Gross Margin
panels.description: Realised trade net as a percentage of cargo spend in the window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
-- MOVING WEIGHTED-AVERAGE COST (sp-7kfof).  Walks every cargo event for each
-- (hull, good) in chronological order: a purchase adds its spend and units and so
-- re-averages the holding, a sale releases units at the THEN-CURRENT average.  The
-- value left standing at any instant is therefore what was actually paid for the
-- units still held.
--
-- IT REPLACES A LIFETIME AVERAGE, which is the defect this fixes.  The previous
-- valuation multiplied net units held by total spend / total units over ALL history
-- - two different populations.  The units held come from specific recent lots; the
-- average came from every lot ever bought.  On TORWIND-2F5 that valued 60 EQUIPMENT
-- bought at 1,983/u at 2,633.9/u and 105 URANITE bought at 3,394/u at 3,277.5/u; the
-- errors did not cancel, closing came out 641,517 against 602,850 actually paid, and
-- the 38,667 gap ate the COGS denominator until the row read 1212.7% on a 31.7% run.
--
-- sp-d767k IS HONOURED AND STRENGTHENED.  That rule says held cargo is per-(hull,
-- good) NET units - bought minus sold - and must NEVER be derived from a last-sell
-- timestamp, because hulls interleave lots and a hull that sold an OLDER lot after
-- buying a NEWER one had its whole inventory erased.  Walking every event in order
-- is strictly stronger than the net-units subtraction it replaces: it cannot be
-- fooled by interleaving because it never looks at an aggregate at all.
ev AS (
  SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, t.metadata->>'good_symbol' AS good,
         t.created_at, (t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO') AS is_buy,
         (t.metadata->>'units')::numeric AS units, (-t.amount)::numeric AS spend,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.metadata->>'ship_symbol', t.metadata->>'good_symbol'
                            ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id) AS rn
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
     AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'good_symbol','') <> ''
     AND t.created_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
walk AS (
  SELECT hull, good, rn, created_at,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN units ELSE 0 END AS units,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN spend ELSE 0 END AS value
    FROM ev WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.hull, e.good, e.rn, e.created_at,
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.units + e.units ELSE GREATEST(w.units - e.units, 0) END,
         -- A sale releases units at the running average.  Clamped at zero so a sale
         -- of cargo this ledger never saw bought (or a partial history) can only ever
         -- empty the holding, never drive its value negative into the COGS below.
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.value + e.spend
              WHEN w.units > 0 THEN GREATEST(w.value - e.units * (w.value / w.units), 0)
              ELSE 0 END
    FROM walk w JOIN ev e ON e.hull = w.hull AND e.good = w.good AND e.rn = w.rn + 1),
inv AS (
  -- Inventory value per hull at each window boundary, from the walk above.
  SELECT b.asof, x.hull, SUM(x.value)::bigint AS value
    FROM (VALUES ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)) AS b(asof)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.hull, w.good) w.hull, w.value
        FROM walk w WHERE w.created_at < b.asof
       ORDER BY w.hull, w.good, w.rn DESC) x
   GROUP BY 1, 2),
w AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS spent,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount)  FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)     AS earned
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at))
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (w.earned - c.cogs) / NULLIF(c.cogs, 0), 1) AS "margin"
  FROM w CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(value) FROM inv WHERE asof = $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), 0)
         + w.spent
         - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(value) FROM inv WHERE asof = $__timeTo()::timestamptz), 0) AS cogs) c;

panels.title: Realised Net / Hour
panels.description: Trade net divided by the length of the selected window, so 30m / 2h / 24h are comparable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)
       / NULLIF(EXTRACT(epoch FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) / 3600.0, 0))::bigint
       AS "net per hour"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.description: Ships on the trade coordinator right now: tags trade (legacy path), trade-mvt (MVT loop) and trade-lane (specialists).

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "trade hulls"
  FROM ships s CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE s.player_id = me.pid AND s.dedicated_fleet IN ('trade','trade-mvt','trade-lane');

panels.title: Capital in Cargo (at cost)
panels.description: Credits spent in this window on cargo not yet sold, valued at purchase price.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
open_cargo AS (
  -- Held cargo is per-(hull, good) NET units - bought minus sold - valued at that
  -- hull's average purchase cost for the good.  Deliberately NOT derived from a
  -- last-sell timestamp: hulls interleave lots, so a hull that sold an OLDER lot
  -- after buying a NEWER one had its entire held inventory erased (sp-d767k).
  -- units/good_symbol come from transactions.metadata, which carries both
  -- structurally on every cargo row - no description parsing.
  SELECT g.hull, COALESCE(SUM(g.net_units * g.avg_unit_cost), 0)::bigint AS open_cost
    FROM (
      SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull,
             t.metadata->>'good_symbol' AS good,
             COALESCE(SUM((t.metadata->>'units')::numeric)
                        FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0)
           - COALESCE(SUM((t.metadata->>'units')::numeric)
                        FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)     AS net_units,
             COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount)
                        FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0)
           / NULLIF(SUM((t.metadata->>'units')::numeric)
                        FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS avg_unit_cost
        FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
       WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
         AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
         AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
         AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'good_symbol','') <> ''
         AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
       GROUP BY 1, 2) g
   WHERE g.net_units > 0 AND g.avg_unit_cost IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oc.open_cost), 0) AS "in cargo"
  FROM open_cargo oc;

panels.title: Best Hull
panels.description: Highest realised net in the window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
tx AS (SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS net
         FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
        WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> '' AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
        GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT hull || '   ' || to_char(net, 'FM999G999G999') || ' CR'
                   FROM tx ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 1), 'no hull traded in window') AS "best hull";

panels.title: Worst Hull
panels.description: Lowest realised net in the window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
tx AS (SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS net
         FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
        WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> '' AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
        GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT hull || '   ' || to_char(net, 'FM999G999G999') || ' CR'
                   FROM tx ORDER BY net ASC LIMIT 1), 'no hull traded in window') AS "worst hull";

panels.title: Per-Hull P&L - realised, deployed, and honest net
panels.description: One row per hull in the trade fleet, plus any that traded in the window and has since been released; tour operations only.

defaults.noValue: No trade-fleet hulls and no tour cargo transactions in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
-- MOVING WEIGHTED-AVERAGE COST (sp-7kfof).  Walks every cargo event for each
-- (hull, good) in chronological order: a purchase adds its spend and units and so
-- re-averages the holding, a sale releases units at the THEN-CURRENT average.  The
-- value left standing at any instant is therefore what was actually paid for the
-- units still held.
--
-- IT REPLACES A LIFETIME AVERAGE, which is the defect this fixes.  The previous
-- valuation multiplied net units held by total spend / total units over ALL history
-- - two different populations.  The units held come from specific recent lots; the
-- average came from every lot ever bought.  On TORWIND-2F5 that valued 60 EQUIPMENT
-- bought at 1,983/u at 2,633.9/u and 105 URANITE bought at 3,394/u at 3,277.5/u; the
-- errors did not cancel, closing came out 641,517 against 602,850 actually paid, and
-- the 38,667 gap ate the COGS denominator until the row read 1212.7% on a 31.7% run.
--
-- sp-d767k IS HONOURED AND STRENGTHENED.  That rule says held cargo is per-(hull,
-- good) NET units - bought minus sold - and must NEVER be derived from a last-sell
-- timestamp, because hulls interleave lots and a hull that sold an OLDER lot after
-- buying a NEWER one had its whole inventory erased.  Walking every event in order
-- is strictly stronger than the net-units subtraction it replaces: it cannot be
-- fooled by interleaving because it never looks at an aggregate at all.
ev AS (
  SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, t.metadata->>'good_symbol' AS good,
         t.created_at, (t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO') AS is_buy,
         (t.metadata->>'units')::numeric AS units, (-t.amount)::numeric AS spend,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.metadata->>'ship_symbol', t.metadata->>'good_symbol'
                            ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id) AS rn
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
     AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'good_symbol','') <> ''
     AND t.created_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
walk AS (
  SELECT hull, good, rn, created_at,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN units ELSE 0 END AS units,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN spend ELSE 0 END AS value
    FROM ev WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.hull, e.good, e.rn, e.created_at,
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.units + e.units ELSE GREATEST(w.units - e.units, 0) END,
         -- A sale releases units at the running average.  Clamped at zero so a sale
         -- of cargo this ledger never saw bought (or a partial history) can only ever
         -- empty the holding, never drive its value negative into the COGS below.
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.value + e.spend
              WHEN w.units > 0 THEN GREATEST(w.value - e.units * (w.value / w.units), 0)
              ELSE 0 END
    FROM walk w JOIN ev e ON e.hull = w.hull AND e.good = w.good AND e.rn = w.rn + 1),
inv AS (
  -- Inventory value per hull at each window boundary, from the walk above.
  SELECT b.asof, x.hull, SUM(x.value)::bigint AS value
    FROM (VALUES ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)) AS b(asof)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.hull, w.good) w.hull, w.value
        FROM walk w WHERE w.created_at < b.asof
       ORDER BY w.hull, w.good, w.rn DESC) x
   GROUP BY 1, 2),
tx AS (
  SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO')            AS buys,
         COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS spent,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO')                AS sells,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)      AS earned,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)                                               AS net
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
     AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
   GROUP BY 1),
cogs AS (
  -- opening inventory + purchases in window - closing inventory.  A hull flat at
  -- BOTH boundaries has opening = closing = 0, so this collapses to the window's own
  -- spend and the margin below reduces to (earned - spent)/spent exactly - the
  -- healthy case is preserved by construction, re-proved against the new valuation
  -- rule rather than inherited from sp-4gcts.
  SELECT tx.hull, COALESCE(io.value, 0) + COALESCE(tx.spent, 0) - COALESCE(ic.value, 0) AS cogs
    FROM tx
    LEFT JOIN inv io ON io.hull = tx.hull AND io.asof = $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    LEFT JOIN inv ic ON ic.hull = tx.hull AND ic.asof = $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
fleet AS (SELECT s.* FROM ships s CROSS JOIN me
           WHERE s.player_id = me.pid AND s.dedicated_fleet IN ('trade','trade-mvt','trade-lane'))
SELECT COALESCE(f.ship_symbol, tx.hull)                              AS "Hull",
       CASE WHEN f.ship_symbol IS NULL              THEN 'RELEASED'
            WHEN COALESCE(tx.sells,0) > 0           THEN 'TRADING'
            WHEN COALESCE(f.cargo_units,0) > 0      THEN 'MID-RUN'
            WHEN COALESCE(tx.buys,0)  > 0           THEN 'MID-RUN'
            WHEN COALESCE(f.assignment_status,'') = 'active'
             AND COALESCE(f.container_id,'') LIKE 'tour-run-%'
                                                    THEN 'ON TOUR'
            ELSE 'IDLE' END                                          AS "State",
       COALESCE(tx.buys, 0)                                          AS "Buys",
       COALESCE(tx.sells, 0)                                         AS "Sells",
       COALESCE(tx.spent, 0)                                         AS "Spent",
       COALESCE(tx.earned, 0)                                        AS "Earned",
       COALESCE(tx.net, 0)                                           AS "Realised Net",
       -- Cargo held at the window's END, valued by the SAME walk the COGS uses
       -- (sp-7kfof).  It used to be a separate window-clipped average that could
       -- disagree with the closing inventory on the very same row - 602,850 against
       -- 641,517 on TORWIND-2F5 - which is indefensible for two readings of one
       -- quantity, so they are now one number by construction.
       COALESCE(ic.value, 0)                                         AS "In Cargo",
       COALESCE(tx.net, 0) + COALESCE(ic.value, 0)                   AS "Net @ Cost",
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(tx.sells,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(cg.cogs,0) > 0
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(tx.earned,0) - cg.cogs) / cg.cogs, 1)
            END                                                      AS "Margin %",
       COALESCE(f.cargo_units, 0)                                    AS "Hold",
       COALESCE(f.cargo_capacity, 0)                                 AS "Cap",
       COALESCE(f.system_symbol, '-')                                AS "System",
       COALESCE(f.nav_status, '-')                                   AS "Nav",
       COALESCE(substring(f.container_id from '[0-9a-f]{8}$'), '-') AS "Tour"
  FROM tx
  FULL OUTER JOIN fleet f ON f.ship_symbol = tx.hull
  LEFT JOIN cogs cg ON cg.hull = COALESCE(f.ship_symbol, tx.hull)
  LEFT JOIN inv  ic ON ic.hull = COALESCE(f.ship_symbol, tx.hull) AND ic.asof = $__timeTo()::timestamptz
 ORDER BY COALESCE(tx.net, 0) DESC;

panels.title: Realised Net by Hull
panels.description: Realised tour net per hull over the window, worst to best.

defaults.noValue: No hull traded on a tour in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS "Hull", COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS "Realised Net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC;

panels.title: Cumulative Net by Hull
panels.description: Running realised net per hull across the window.

defaults.noValue: No hull traded on a tour in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
b AS (SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.created_at, $__interval),
             t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS metric,
             COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS v
        FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
       WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
         AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
       GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT time, metric, SUM(v) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY time) AS value
  FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: MVT loop  (trade-mvt hulls: claim -> travel -> trade until exhausted)
Hulls by tag
panels.description: trade-mvt runs the loop, trade-lane the specialist cross-system tours, trade the legacy path.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dedicated_fleet = 'trade-mvt')::bigint AS "mvt",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dedicated_fleet = 'trade-lane')::bigint AS "specialist",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dedicated_fleet IN ('trade','trade-mvt','trade-lane'))::bigint AS "legacy"
  FROM ships WHERE player_id = $player;

panels.title: Loop movement rate (window)
panels.description: arrived = a completed jump to a claimed system; empty = the solver found no intra-system plan; yield = the departure rule fired.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (SELECT EXTRACT(epoch FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) / 3600.0 AS hours)
SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'arrived'))::numeric
             / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT hull), 0) / NULLIF((SELECT hours FROM w), 0), 2) AS "jumps / hull-hour",
       ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'empty'))::numeric
             / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT hull), 0) / NULLIF((SELECT hours FROM w), 0), 2) AS "exhaustion exits / hull-hour",
       ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'yield_below_alternative'))::numeric
             / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT hull), 0) / NULLIF((SELECT hours FROM w), 0), 2) AS "yield departures / hull-hour"
  FROM mvt_transitions
 WHERE player_id = $player AND reason <> 'shadow' AND $__timeFilter(at);

panels.title: Claims now
panels.description: From trade_claims: hulls flying to their claim vs trading in it, and how many distinct systems the fleet holds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.arrived_at IS NULL)::bigint AS "in transit",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.arrived_at IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS "trading",
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.system)::bigint AS "systems claimed"
  FROM trade_claims c JOIN ships s ON s.player_id = c.player_id AND s.ship_symbol = c.hull
 WHERE c.player_id = $player AND s.dedicated_fleet = 'trade-mvt';

panels.title: Loop trouble (window)
panels.description: Failure-mode transitions: fail toward staying put, so these should stay near zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'travel_failed')::bigint AS "travel failed",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'hold')::bigint AS "held",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'no_alternative')::bigint AS "no alternative",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'ranker_unreadable')::bigint AS "ranker unreadable"
  FROM mvt_transitions
 WHERE player_id = $player AND $__timeFilter(at);

panels.title: Loop transitions by reason
panels.description: One row per hull state change. arrived and empty dominate when hulls drain small systems in one pass; yield_below_alternative is the MVT departure rule proper.

defaults.noValue: no loop transitions in this window

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval), reason AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS v
  FROM mvt_transitions
 WHERE player_id = $player AND reason <> 'shadow' AND $__timeFilter(at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Claims per system (now)
panels.description: The claim is a penalty, not a lock: two hulls on one system is allowed, a pile-up is the ranker's in-transit penalty failing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.system AS "System", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Hulls"
  FROM trade_claims c JOIN ships s ON s.player_id = c.player_id AND s.ship_symbol = c.hull
 WHERE c.player_id = $player AND s.dedicated_fleet = 'trade-mvt'
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Hull state - where each loop hull is and what it did in the window
panels.description: State from trade_claims (TRAVEL until arrived_at is stamped), last transition from mvt_transitions, jumps/exhaustions in the window, realised tour net in the window (naive sum; see ledger positions for lot-matched).

targets.rawSql:
WITH hulls AS (
  SELECT s.ship_symbol, s.dedicated_fleet, s.system_symbol, s.nav_status, s.cargo_units, s.cargo_capacity
    FROM ships s WHERE s.player_id = $player AND s.dedicated_fleet IN ('trade-mvt','trade-lane')),
net AS (
  SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS v,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO') AS sells
    FROM transactions t

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT t.created_at,
         CASE WHEN t.operation_type = 'tour'
               AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
               AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
              THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END AS trade_v,
         CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_SHIP'
               AND t.metadata->>'ship_type' IN ('SHIP_HEAVY_FREIGHTER','SHIP_LIGHT_HAULER','SHIP_BULK_FREIGHTER')
              THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END AS capex_v
    FROM transactions t
   WHERE t.player_id = $player),
b AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
         COALESCE(SUM(trade_v), 0) AS trade_v,
         COALESCE(SUM(capex_v), 0) AS capex_v
    FROM ev
   GROUP BY 1),
c AS (
  SELECT time,
         SUM(trade_v) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS net,
         SUM(capex_v) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS capex
    FROM b)
-- Deliberately unfiltered by time.  Both series must carry their true cumulative
-- level at the left edge of whatever window is shown, so the running sums span the
-- whole era and the panel axis does the clipping.  A time macro on the grouped
-- column would not work here anyway: it is an epoch number, not a timestamptz.
SELECT time,
       net   AS "Cumulative Trade Net",
       capex AS "Cumulative Trade-Hull Capex"
  FROM c
 ORDER BY 1;
